message: User requested a UI polish pass on Antigravity-owned files. Please improve src/components/career-assistant.tsx and src/components/landing-page.tsx, plus any required owned layout/CSS files, with priority on: (1) chatbot small-size scrollability and overflow, (2) better spacing and less congestion in compact assistant mode, (3) smoother motion and cleaner hierarchy, (4) landing-page uniformity, spacing rhythm, readability, and smoother interactions. Keep the monochrome direction, preserve responsiveness, and do not break the new Codex backend endpoints: POST /api/ai/resume and POST /api/ai/resume/pdf.
